title: Cult of Azazel
description: A mod that adds a mansion-like structure to Nether
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4ef222000a010a2c12d021ff186095f587434d6c.gif)

![description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/17ab372e3b45722636b26b36c8fc13b7a8821cb8.png)

**Cult of Azazel** - A mod that adds a massive new dungeon to Nether, divided into 3 zones. At the end, you’ll face a battle with the final boss, who will reward you with new items. Each zone serves a specific purpose and benefits the god Azazel. Also mod adds a massive Maze in overworld with second boss - True Azazel and many small structures.

This mod adds over 10+ new mobs with unique mechanics,8+ secondary-small structures, and a 2 main structures

Nether now also has its own version of bees - **they’re quite useful in the search**.
